name: Sigenergy Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Sigenergy Technology Co., Ltd develops and manufactures energy storage systems, inverters, and related smart energy solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. It offers Sigenstor, 5-in-one energy storage systems; Sigen LoadHub, a backup power solution provides intelligent energy management and monitoring; Sigen backup switch, a plug and play backup solution; SigenMicro inverter; Sigen EV DC charging modules; and Sigen EV AC chargers. The company serves commercial and industrial clients, businesses, communities, the aquaculture sector, and residential clients.
